svg.title: A compact basis does not pass the nominal trust gate
svg.desc: POD singular-value decay and nominal-holdout errors normalised by the frozen field, exposure and duration gates. Both POD and POD-DEIM exceed at least one nominal gate, so shift reliability is inadmissible in this phase.
